bio1: I'm Harry Chang. I build safety systems for language models, take photographs on a camera with no screen, and argue for positions I'm not sure I believe in.
bio2: Incoming at NTU CSIE this fall. I work across research, photography, debate, and the occasional film — whichever one the day needs.
bio3: None of it is as separate as it looks. Every page here connects to another; if you'd rather see the whole shape at once, there's a graph for that.
